challenge.speaker: npc
challenge.text: Stop there. The undercroft is shut on the seneschal's word, and I am the word after that.

choices.text: I only need a moment inside.
Step aside, or I'll move you.
It's the third watch. Nobody is checking.

persuade.speaker: npc
persuade.text: A moment. That is what the last one said, and they carried out a reliquary under a cloak.

choices.text: You've seen me here before. You know I'm not that.
Then search me on the way out.

intimidate.speaker: npc
intimidate.text: You will move me. In front of the gate, in daylight, with two more on the wall behind me.

bribe.speaker: npc
bribe.text: ...Put that away. Put it away and go left at the second stair, and I never saw your face.

seneschal_writ.speaker: npc
seneschal_writ.text: Then you will have his mark on you. ...You do. Go on, and be quick about it.

night_angle.speaker: npc
night_angle.text: I am checking. That is the entire job. But the third watch is long and I would rather not spend it arguing.

choices.text: So let it be a short argument.

relent.speaker: npc
relent.text: One turn of the glass. If anyone asks, you came out the way you went in.

withdraw.speaker: player
withdraw.text: You step back from the gate and let the matter rest.
